help.description: Show help and documentation for commands and topics.

options.--all: Show complete help for all commands and topics
options.--json: Output help information in JSON format
options.--examples: Show examples for a specific command

man.description: Display a detailed manual page for a command.

projects.description: List projects loaded from a static JSON file with optional filtering.

skills.description: Display skills with proficiency, usage areas, and context.

experience.description: Display work history, research roles at IIT (BHU) and C-DAC, key responsibilities, and technologies used.

cd.description: Navigate through the virtual filesystem. Explore folders via 'cd projects', 'cd skills', 'cd experiences', and their subdirectories.

ls.description: Lists virtual files and directories in the current or specified directory in a responsive grid or detailed table.

cat.description: Reads and renders simulated file content to the terminal screen.

tree.summary: List contents of directories in a tree format
tree.description: Displays a visual ASCII tree of the entire portfolio filesystem or a target directory.

theme.description: Allows switching between different terminal color schemes: default, matrix, dracula, gruvbox, nord, amber.

crt.description: Toggles retro cathode-ray-tube scanline styling overlay on the terminal viewport.

ranger.summary: Interactive terminal file manager with Miller columns
ranger.description: Curses/TUI-style file navigator. Browse virtual directories with arrow keys (or h/j/k/l), inspect live text and directory previews, and change working directories upon exit.

neofetch.summary: Display author identity, roles, and compact system banner
neofetch.description: Fastfetch/Neofetch inspired system overview displaying author name, current position at C-DAC (National Supercomputing Mission), former deputation at IIT (BHU) Varanasi, profile links, and ANSI color swatches.

alias.summary: Display list of all defined command shortcuts and aliases
alias.description: Prints an aligned table of all shortcut commands (e.g. c -> clear, q -> exit, ll -> ls -l, r -> ranger).

clear.description: Clear all output from the terminal.
